summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting an expanded work program on its Queensway Gold Project. The program is fully funded at $44M, with 90,000 m of drilling using six diamond rigs, focusing on discovery and resource growth, including deep drilling and step-out tests. The company aims to advance toward first ore processed in late 2027. No specific deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
